title: Variant ladder: base -> amplified -> maximal exploitation of ONE finding
description: The maximal-exploitation stage's artifact. Chaining composes ACROSS confirmed findings; this ladder searches WITHIN one: capital minimization, precondition removal, role conflation, ordering permutation, payout-cap saturation. Every rung above base counts only if reproduced (its own EXEC record); the finding's claim pins to the highest reproduced rung.

axes_explored.description: an axis is explored when it was CONSIDERED and its outcome recorded (a variant rung or a disproved rung with reason); not-applicable still needs the recorded note

axis_notes.description: per-axis operator note: what was considered and why the outcome stands

capital_usd.description: attacker capital this rung needs, priced at the campaign price table

extraction_ratio.description: share of the exploitable pool this rung extracts (1.0 = 100%)

removed_preconditions.description: base preconditions this rung does NOT need (e.g. 'victim stakes' — the depositor only deposits)

exec_id.description: EXEC record backing this rung; required for status=reproduced

evidence_id.description: evidence item minted from exec_id onto the finding

reason.description: why disproved / why assumed; required for disproved rungs

maximal_rung_id.description: the reproduced rung the finding's claim pins to; must have status=reproduced
